name: Program Charter & Frozen Evidence Registry
purpose: Freeze program scope and evidence sources before any comparison.

name: Comparison Protocol Registration
purpose: Pre-register statistical methods, thresholds, missing-data policy, robustness rules, and interpretation standards.

name: Data Inventory & Alignment Audit
purpose: Audit construct output availability, common sample, missingness, and date alignment.

name: Pairwise Dependence Mapping
purpose: Measure pairwise linear, rank, and nonlinear dependence across frozen construct outputs.

name: Incremental Information Analysis
purpose: Test whether each construct adds information beyond other constructs under preregistered models.

name: Robustness & Sensitivity Analysis
purpose: Evaluate stability across windows, periods, common/max samples, and bootstrap procedures.

name: Redundancy & Orthogonality Classification
purpose: Classify construct relationships as redundant, partially redundant, complementary, orthogonal, or inconclusive.

name: Complementarity & Multivariate Information Analysis
purpose: Evaluate multivariate information structure and construct combinations without trading interpretation.

name: Hierarchical / Lead-Lag Relationship Study
purpose: Analyze temporal ordering and upstream/downstream associations without causal claims.

name: Information Architecture Synthesis
purpose: Build evidence-weighted construct ecosystem taxonomy from completed comparison evidence.

name: Scientific Interpretation Review
purpose: Audit interpretation quality, literature consistency, over-claiming, and causal-language violations.

name: Final Construct Ecosystem Review
purpose: Produce the final Construct Information Matrix and ecosystem architecture.
